author: 圣经
quote_zh: 那一千年完了，撒但必从监牢里被释放，出来要迷惑地上四方的列国，就是歌革和玛各，叫他们聚集争战。他们的人数多如海沙。
quote_en: And it shall come to pass at the end of that thousand years, that Satan shall be released from his prison, and shall come forth to deceive the nations that are upon the face of the earth, Gog and Magog, that they may assemble and fight. They are as numerous as the sand of the sea.
